canonicalStep.title: cowl-microfilter-cover (BMW 328i draft Cabin Air Filter guide; evidence step 2, 3)

elements.describe: A long black plastic cover running along the base of the windshield in the engine bay, in front of the wipers.
The 8 mm screws that hold the cover and its ducts; shown as screw heads without a specific count.
Wiper arms resting against the windshield above the cover, for orientation.
The lower edge of the windshield behind the cover.
Unestablished detail of cover screw points: Screw count (3/4/6) and positions conflict between sources and the 2010 car is unverified.
Unestablished detail of microfilter cover: Exact cover outline, duct shape and seam lines are not established; show a generic long black cover.
